Here is a sample Semgrep rule in YAML format for the given vulnerability and patched code:

```yaml
id: vuln-braces-abdafb0c
title: "Potential XSS Vulnerability"
description: "This rule detects potential Cross Site Scripting (XSS) via brace notation in JavaScript."
severity: WARNING
languages:
  - javascript
metadata:
  tags:
    - xss
  confidence: high
pattern:
  - '(function|var|const|let).*\\bset\\b.*\\bbrace\\b'
```

This rule will look for any function, variable declaration, constant, or let that uses the `set` method and includes a brace notation. The pattern is written in regex to match these cases. 

Please note that this is a very basic example and might not cover all possible ways of XSS vulnerabilities. You should adjust it according to your specific use case.
